about: Windows programs the App Bridge recognises, matched by lower-case words found in the file name, product name or publisher. storeId is the AppStream id the Store opens with wildos-store --app. runs is how the Windows version did when Wild OS tried it under Wine: well, some, no or absent when not tried; the dialog words it as Wild OS's own testing, not as reports from other people. reason is shown when runs is no. calls marks a calling app: the dialog offers its Wild OS version first and Windows mode second (WinModeCalls.dc), webApp being the address its Wild OS version opens when it has no package.
